requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS (B2B product analytics) wants to move from Hosted API POC to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. Primary workloads: embedding-backed doc search + reranking for product help articles, chat-based support assistant for customers. Targets: p50 latency <=150ms (chat), sustained throughput 80-150 reqs/s for reranking, peak bursts to 300 reqs/s. Cost sensitive: wants committed reserved pricing with predictable monthly ARR. Needs VPC peering, KMS-managed keys, SSO/SAML for access, audit logs retained 1 year, EU data residency for subset of data. Requires SLA with clear SLOs and credits, and DPA with strict deletion/retention terms.
